findings.summary: Hot-cache identity and detached builds omit the package pin/materializer and never materialize or pass the override before cache get/build.
All-eight package publication has no durable transaction marker or startup recovery after process interruption.
Timeout cleanup can return after the direct child exits while another process-group member remains active.
Lake update modes bypass package overrides; the workflow does not yet enforce a non-update invocation boundary.
A detached warm requires an ignored Mathlib lake-manifest before package materialization, so a clean detached clone cannot reach Lake.
Lake -U and bundled short options that enable dependency updates bypass the no-update boundary.
Package names accept traversal components and are joined into archive, staging, recovery, and destination paths.
A symlinked .lake parent redirects runtime, package, and override operations outside the repository.
Same-process rollback abandons the held transaction, backup, and stage descriptors and reopens the transaction pathname, breaking restoration when that pathname names a different directory instance.

finding.summary: The production parser rejects canonical codeload root directories with mode 0775 before any package facts can be captured.
